title: 宣戦！？いっちょセンター！

text_block_list.text: "I wanna be on stage when I tell everyone about my plan to win every race."
To fulfill Smart Falcon's request, I set up a mini concert with the promise of a huge announcement. Fans come flooding in from all around.

text_block_list.name: Falco Fan
text_block_list.text: The concert was sooo good! I can't wait to hear this big announcement!

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: There's no way I could afford to miss an announcement from someone as popular as Smart Falcon! I'm going to be the first to put out an article!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Thank you for joining me here today, everyone! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: And now, as you've heard, I have an announcement to announ—huh?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ahem! ☆ I have an announcement to make!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Ohhhhh?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Hehe, are you curious? Put your hands together if you are! ☆
Clap, clap, clap, clap!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ooh, that sounds like everyone! Great! Okay… here I go!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I hereby declare that I will finish first in each of the following races!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: …? Ohhhh?
The crowd seems confused at first. However, as Smart Falcon reels off the names of the races, their expressions change.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: …And finally, the Tokyo Daishoten! I'll be standing center stage in each and every one! ☆

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Falco Fan
text_block_list.text: A-amazing! I've got to post about this on Umat—oh?! It's already trending?!

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: A victory declaration! It looks like we're going to see a different Smart Falcon this year…

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: Hello? I've got a special report to put out, so get everything ready!

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: The headline? How about… "Birth of the Undisputed Champion of Dirt? Smart Falcon Promises Victory!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: …Ooh, my announcement is trending at number one! It's really got some traction!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Now, I bet everyone's gonna want to see if I can win or not.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Phew… There's no turning back now. I have to win. ☆

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Falcon.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Hey, Flash! Are you going for lunch?
Eishin Flash is Falcon's roommate and a rising star in her own right, albeit on turf.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: No, I just happened to see you…

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Oh? You're pretty smitten with me, huh? ☆

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Assuming someone likes you just because they said hello is what they call "jumping to conclusions."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Whoa, whoa, whoa! Don't go cold on me all of a sudden!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: …By the way, that declaration you just made has become quite the hot topic.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Oh, did you see it? Hehe, I knew you were a fan! ☆

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Actually, I was just curious about what you were up to, considering you're usually so disorganized.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: And it looks like you were able to put together a proper schedule. Not only for the short term, but all the way to the end of the year.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: T-that doesn't feel like a compliment, but… thanks, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: That said… If you plan things out too much, I think you might lose that feeling of Falcon charm.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: …Never mind. Forget what I said. Please do your best to follow your admirable schedule.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Did Flash just take back what she said?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: She's usually never afraid to speak her mind… Wonder what was up.
choice_data_list: Why don't you ask when you get back to the dorm?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Hm, I suppose I could… Oh!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Almost forgot—so after the concert, someone gave me their business card and said they want to interview me.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I bet there'll be plenty more where that came from, so let's get my schedule sorted out now!
Although Eishin Flash's words spark my curiosity, I soon find myself getting snowed under by a rapid succession of interview requests.
